changes.before: Proposed West Virginia-Powered Data Center Incentive Act; tax and incentive structure for data centers.
changes.after: Introduced West Virginia-Powered Data Center Incentive Act proposes personal-property salvage valuation, sales/use-tax relief and coal-electricity utility B&O treatment. Eligibility includes West Virginia location, at least $50 million new capital investment on or after January1,2025, at least50 new jobs and coal-generated electricity for at least80% of primary operational capacity; backup/redundancy/secondary capacity is excluded. Coal-generated electricity separately requires at least75% coal-derived energy from a plant burning West Virginia coal or located in the state. The printed data-center capacity definition supplies no numeric MW threshold. Introduced SB583 uses four6H cross-references despite creating article6N. SB857 changes those references to6N; the source texts are not identical. Incentives and conditions are proposals, not enacted treatment.
